The sigma that the normalized Laplacian with gamma 1 picks at the center of a bright disk on a 97 by 97 image. The stack has 41 scales from 1 to 16, so neighboring sigmas differ by a factor of about 1.07. At the center of a disk of height 1, the heat equation gives t times the Laplacian of L as -(r^2 / t) exp(-r^2 / (2 t)). Its size is largest at t = r^2 / 2, so at sigma = r / sqrt 2. The selected sigma matches it to within one step of the stack.
